detaileddescription.para: Calling this function resets the device immediately, and any pending transmission or reception is terminated at once. Both Object Layer and Transfer Layer are reset. This function does not reset the Physical Layer. All registers are reset to the default values, and no previous status is restored. TX FIFO, RX FIFO and TX High Priority Buffer are also reset.

When an internal error requires a reset, the driver notifies the upper layer software through the error status code or interrupts. The upper layer software is responsible for calling this Reset function and then re-configuring the device.
The CAN device is in Configuration Mode immediately after this function returns.

detaileddescription.para: First checks if TX FIFO is full. If not, it then writes the given frame into the TX FIFO; otherwise, it returns error code immediately. This function does not wait for the given frame being sent to CAN bus.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.
Pointer to a 32-bit aligned buffer containing the CAN frame to be sent.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if TX FIFO was not full and the given frame was written into the FIFO.
XST_FIFO_NO_ROOM if there is no room in the TX FIFO for the given frame.

detaileddescription.para: First checks if RX FIFO is empty, if not, it then reads a frame from the RX FIFO into the given buffer. Returns error code immediately if there is no frame in the RX FIFO.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.
Pointer to a 32-bit aligned buffer where the CAN frame to be written.

listitem.para:
XST_SUCCESS if RX FIFO was not empty and a frame was read from RX FIFO successfully and written into the given buffer.
XST_NO_DATA if there is no frame to be received from the FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Sends a CAN frame through the High Priority Buffer.

detaileddescription.para: First checks if TX High Priority Buffer is empty. If yes, it then writes the given frame into the Buffer. If not, returns immediately. This function does not wait for the given frame being sent to CAN bus.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.
Pointer to a 32-bit aligned buffer containing the CAN High Priority frame to be sent.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if TX High Priority Buffer was not full and the given frame was written into the buffer.
XST_FIFO_NO_ROOM if there is no room in the TX High Priority Buffer for this frame.

simplesect.para: To send the frame immediately, without a delay from processor interrupt handling, disable interrupts at the processor level before invoking this function.

detaileddescription.para: Up to 4 filters could be enabled.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.

Specifies which filters to enable. Use any XCAN_AFR_UAF*_MASK to enable one filter, and apply a bitwise OR to multiple XCAN_AFR_UAF*_MASK values if multiple filters need to be enabled. Any filter not specified in this parameter keeps its previous enable/disable setting.

simplesect.para: Acceptance Filter Register is an optional register in Xilinx CAN device. If it is NOT existing in the device, this function should NOT be used. Calling this function in this case causes an assertion failure.

detaileddescription.para: Up to 4 filters could be disabled. If all acceptance filters are disabled then all received frames are stored in the RX FIFO.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.

Any filter not specified in this parameter keeps its previous enable/disable setting. If all acceptance filters are disabled then all received frames are stored in the RX FIFO.

simplesect.para: Acceptance Filter Register is an optional register in Xilinx CAN device. If it is NOT existing in the device, this function should NOT be used. Calling this function in this case causes an assertion failure.

detaileddescription.para: Use XCAN_AFR_UAF*_MASK defined in xcan_l.h to interpret the returned value. If no acceptance filters are enabled then all received frames are stored in the RX FIFO.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.

briefdescription.para: Runs a self-test on the CAN driver/device.

detaileddescription.para: The test resets the device and sets up the Loop Back mode. It then sends a standard frame, receives the frame, verifies the contents, and resets the device again.
Note that this is a destructive test in that resets of the device are performed. Refer to the device specification for the device status after the reset operation.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.

listitem.para:
XST_SUCCESS if the self-test passed, that is, the frame received via the internal loop back has the same contents as the sent frame.
XST_FAILURE Otherwise.

simplesect.para:
If the CAN device does not work properly, this function may enter an infinite loop and never returns to the caller.
If XST_FAILURE is returned, the device is not reset so that the caller could have a chance to check reasons causing the failure.

detaileddescription.para: This handler reads the interrupt status from the ISR, determines the source of the interrupts, calls according callbacks, and finally clears the interrupts.

Application beyond this driver is responsible for providing callbacks to handle interrupts and installing the callbacks using XCan_SetHandler() during initialization phase. An example delivered with this driver demonstrates how this could be done.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance that just interrupted.

briefdescription.para: Installs an asynchronous callback for the specified handler type.

para.preformatted: HandlerType Callback Function Type ----------------------- --------------------------- XCAN_HANDLER_SEND XCan_SendRecvHandler XCAN_HANDLER_RECV XCan_SendRecvHandler XCAN_HANDLER_ERROR XCan_ErrorHandler XCAN_HANDLER_EVENT XCan_EventHandler

HandlerType Invoked by this driver when: ----------------------- -------------------------------------------------- XCAN_HANDLER_SEND A frame transmitted by a call to XCan_Send() has been sent successfully.
XCAN_HANDLER_RECV A frame has been received and is sitting in the RX FIFO.
XCAN_HANDLER_ERROR An error interrupt is occurring.
XCAN_HANDLER_EVENT Any other kind of interrupt is occurring.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCan instance to be worked on.
Specifies which handler is to be attached.
Address of the callback function.
Caller-supplied data item passed to the callback function when it is invoked.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when handler is installed.
XST_INVALID_PARAM when HandlerType is invalid.

simplesect.para: Invoking this function for a handler that already has been installed replaces it with the new handler.
